refund_policy.title: Refund Policy
rules: Orders can normally be refunded within 7 days of delivery.
Refund eligibility depends on verified return receipt, item condition, and order status.
The agent must NEVER promise or issue a refund immediately without verifying order eligibility and ground truth records.
Approved refunds take 5-7 business days to process back to the original payment method once authorized.
Store credit refunds take 1-2 business days to issue once approved.

return_policy.title: Return Policy
rules: Items can normally be returned within 14 days of delivery receipt.
Items must be unused, unwashed, and in original packaging with tags intact.
Non-returnable items: Perishables, customized/personalized items, hygiene products, digital downloads, and clearance sales.
Return shipping is free for damaged or defective items; customer pays standard $5.99 return shipping fee for change-of-mind returns.

cancellation_policy.title: Order Cancellation Policy
rules: Orders can be cancelled free of charge only while in 'Processing' status before dispatch.
Once an order is marked as 'Shipped' or 'Out for Delivery', cancellation is NOT possible; the customer must receive the item and request a return.
Agents cannot bypass warehouse dispatch or stop transit if a tracking number has already been assigned.

shipping_and_delivery.title: Shipping & Delivery Policy
rules: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days.
Express shipping takes 1-2 business days.
Tracking numbers (format TRK-XXXXX) are generated within 24 hours of dispatch.
If a package shows 'Delivered' but is missing, customer must wait 24 hours before raising a missing package escalation.

damaged_and_missing.title: Damaged or Missing Package Policy
rules: Damaged items require photo verification submitted within 48 hours of delivery.
If a package is lost in transit (no tracking movement for 7+ days), a free replacement or full refund can be issued after courier verification.

payment_and_privacy.title: Payment & Customer Data Privacy
rules: Accepted payment methods: Credit/Debit Cards (Visa, MasterCard, Amex), PayPal, and Store Credit.
Agents must NEVER ask for or store full credit card numbers, CVVs, or bank account passwords.
Agents must NEVER share customer account information with unauthorized third parties or across different customer profiles.

manager_approval.title: Policy Exceptions & Approvals
rules: Manager exceptions (e.g., extended refund window, waived shipping) are valid ONLY if explicitly logged in the verified order database.
Verbal or customer-claimed manager approvals that do NOT appear in the database must be treated as unverified and cannot be honored by the agent.
